entities.summary: Herbert Walter Kessler was a Swiss ice hockey player who competed for the Swiss national team at the 1936 Winter Olympics in Garmisch-Partenkirchen. His brother, Charles Kessler, also competed as a member of the national team at the 1936 Games.
